result.summary: 本文训练了 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，并在不进行任何梯度更新或微调的情况下，用零样本、单样本和少样本设置评估其性能 [abstract][S1.p9]。GPT-3 在翻译、问答、完形填空以及需要即时推理或领域适应的任务上取得较强表现，少样本设置有时可与此前最优的微调方法竞争 [abstract][S1.p11]。同时，论文也指出 GPT-3 在部分数据集上仍然表现不佳，并存在与大规模网络语料训练相关的方法论问题 [abstract][S1.p13]。作者还发现 GPT-3 生成的新闻文章让人类评估者难以与人类撰写的文章区分，并讨论了更广泛的社会影响 [abstract][S1.p12]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：现有预训练加微调范式虽然架构任务无关，但仍需要每个任务数千到数十万个特定标注样本进行微调 [S1.p2]。作者认为去除这一限制是可取的，因为许多有用语言任务难以收集大规模监督数据，且微调在狭窄任务分布上可能利用伪相关、泛化到分布外较差 [S1.p3][S1.p4]。此外，人类通常只需自然语言指令或极少示例即可学习新语言任务，作者希望 NLP 系统也具备这种灵活性和通用性 [S1.p5]。

evidence.quote: there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning
For many of these tasks it is difficult to collect a large supervised training dataset
the potential to exploit spurious correlations in training data fundamentally grows with the expressiveness of the model
humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks

method.text: 论文训练了 8 个不同规模的模型，参数从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿，其中最大模型称为 GPT-3，架构与 GPT-2 相同但使用交替的稠密和局部带状稀疏注意力模式 [S2.SS1.p1]。训练数据以 Common Crawl 为主，经过质量过滤、模糊去重，并加入 WebText、Books1、Books2 和英文维基百科等高质量语料 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p2]。评估时模型不进行梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定，分为零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置 [abstract][S2.p2]。

evidence.quote: we train 8 different sizes of model, ranging over three orders of magnitude from 125 million parameters to 175 billion parameters
we downloaded and filtered a version of CommonCrawl based on similarity to a range of high-quality reference corpora
we added several curated high-quality datasets, including an expanded version of the WebText dataset
the model is given a few demonstrations of the task at inference time as conditioning, but no weight updates are allowed
GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning, with tasks and few-shot demonstrations specified purely via text interaction with the model

experiments.text: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3，每个任务都在零样本、单样本和少样本三种条件下评估 [S1.p9]。少样本设置中，K 通常为 10 到 100，受模型 2048 token 上下文窗口限制 [S2.p2][S2.SS4.p2]。评估覆盖语言建模、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 风格任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE、NLI，以及算术、单词打乱、SAT 类比、新闻生成等合成或定性任务 [S3.p3]。

evidence.quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation
We typically set $K$ in the range of 10 to 100 as this is how many examples can fit in the model’s context window
which is $n_{\mathrm{ctx}}=2048$ for all models and typically fits $10$ to $100$ examples
In Section 3.9, we invent some additional tasks designed especially to probe in-context learning abilities

findings.text: GPT-3 在零样本和单样本设置下取得有希望的结果，少样本设置有时可与甚至偶尔超过当时最优的微调模型 [S1.p11]。例如在 CoQA 上零样本达到 81.5 F1、单样本 84.0 F1、少样本 85.0 F1；在 TriviaQA 上零样本 64.3%、单样本 68.0%、少样本 71.2% [S1.p11]。GPT-3 还在单词打乱、算术、使用新词等即时推理任务上表现出单样本和少样本能力，并能生成人类难以区分的新闻文章 [S1.p12]。但论文也发现部分任务上少样本表现仍然挣扎，包括 ANLI 等自然语言推理任务以及 RACE、QuAC 等阅读理解数据集 [S1.p13]。

evidence.quote: in the the few-shot setting is sometimes competitive with or even occasionally surpasses state-of-the-art
GPT-3 achieves 81.5 F1 on CoQA in the zero-shot setting, 84.0 F1 on CoQA in the one-shot setting, 85.0 F1 in the few-shot setting
GPT-3 can generate synthetic news articles which human evaluators have difficulty distinguishing from human-generated articles
This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC

limitations.text: 作者承认 GPT-3 在文本合成和若干 NLP 任务上仍有明显弱点，例如长段落中失去连贯性、自相矛盾，以及在“比较”类任务上单样本甚至少样本仅略好于随机 [S5.p2]。结构上，论文只研究自回归语言模型，未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能损害填空、比较两段内容或需要回读长文的任务表现 [S5.p3]。作者还指出，扩大纯自监督预测可能最终触及预训练目标的极限，且 GPT-3 预训练样本效率仍远低于人类 [S5.p4][S5.p5]。此外，少样本学习究竟是在推理时从头学习新任务，还是识别训练中见过的任务，仍存在不确定性 [S5.p6]。

evidence.quote: it still has notable weaknesses in text synthesis and several NLP tasks
it does little better than chance when evaluated one-shot or even few-shot on some “comparison” tasks
our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising
scaling pure self-supervised prediction is likely to hit limits
it still sees much more text during pre-training than a human sees in the their lifetime
ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time
